scope: Independent read-only source, recorded fixture and hash review; no solver or simulation rerun
source_findings: Model axes and complete snapshot grid are validated before use; native geometry/metadata/zero times match the current inputs.
Full ordered Cartesian pair indices, complete/valid/unique flags, branch fields and signed finite derivatives are validated.
Analytic times replace only the truth-time source; station bias, rounding, noise and differential observation order are unchanged.
Invalid input is rejected before arrival or initial-event output; existing simulation outputs are protected.
The actual CLI option and default ordinary behavior are exercised, with six original outputs byte-identical to the frozen prechange implementation.
limitations: The invented homogeneous fixture tests the consumer contract and noise sequence, not arbitrary layered-reference mathematics.
The consumer explicitly does not verify cryptographic provenance. The execution wrapper must verify the prepared bundle hashes immediately before simulation.
No actual Loma simulation, inverse forward acceptance, or production inversion is established by these checks.
